name: Teriyaki Chicken
subtitle: Bottled teriyaki glaze, with sesame cabbage slaw, edamame and rice

macros.portion: About 5½ oz cooked glazed chicken, ¾ cup rice, ½ cup edamame and 1¼ cups slaw.
macros.note: Rough estimate from standard nutrition values for the listed amounts, not a lab number.

before: Chicken thawed in the fridge (allow 1–2 days).
Start the rice first; it takes longer than the chicken.
notes: Use a thick glaze-style sauce, not a thin marinade: a thin one runs off the chicken and tastes mostly of salt. Bottled glazes are thickened with sugar, so they glaze in a minute or two and scorch soon after. Turn the heat down before the sauce goes in. The cornstarch dusting browns the chicken and helps the sauce cling.

items: ⅔ cup thick bottled teriyaki sauce (glaze style)
14 oz bag coleslaw mix (plain shredded cabbage)

steps.title: Rice on
steps.body: Rinse **1 cup rice** until the water runs mostly clear and start it in the rice cooker.

steps.title: Cut and dust the chicken
steps.body: Pat **1¾ lb chicken breast** dry and cut into 1½-inch pieces. In a large bowl, toss with **1½ Tbsp cornstarch** until every piece is lightly coated.

steps.title: Measure the sauce, mix the dressing
steps.body: Measure **⅔ cup teriyaki sauce** into a cup. In a small jar: **2 Tbsp rice vinegar + 2 tsp toasted sesame oil + 2 tsp sugar + 1 tsp soy sauce**, shaken. Slice **2 scallions**.

steps.title: Staging check
steps.body: Within reach: dusted chicken, teriyaki sauce, a clean plate for seared chicken, tongs, and the **2 Tbsp neutral oil**.

steps.title: Sear batch 1
steps.body: Skillet over medium-high until hot. Add **1 Tbsp neutral oil**, then half the chicken in one layer. Leave it **3 min** to brown, turn, and cook 2–3 min more until browned on two sides. Move to the plate.

steps.title: Sear batch 2
steps.body: Add the **other 1 Tbsp neutral oil** and repeat with the rest of the chicken: **3 min**, turn, 2–3 min more. Move to the plate.

steps.title: Sauce the chicken
steps.body: Spoon off any oil left in the pan and turn the heat to medium. Return all the chicken with its juices, pour in the **teriyaki sauce**, and toss 1–2 min until it bubbles, thickens and coats every piece, and the thickest piece reads 160°F. Off the heat.

steps.title: Edamame and slaw
steps.body: Microwave **2 cups edamame** with a splash of water, covered, about 3–4 min, and salt lightly. Toss the dinner share of the **14 oz slaw mix** with its share of the dressing and **sesame seeds**.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Rice, teriyaki chicken with the pan sauce spooned over, edamame, slaw, scallions on top.

after: Pack 2 lunches: rice, chicken and edamame in one container, slaw and dressing kept separate. Dressed cabbage goes watery overnight.
